top_stories.title: BSP eyes lower capital charges for consumer, MSME loans
top_stories.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is proposing lower capital charges for qualified consumer and small-business loans while imposing heavier requirements on riskier property and project financing as it updates banking rules in line with Basel III standards.
top_stories.why_it_matters: This matters because it changes how more than one important group can build, buy, deploy, secure, or govern technology.

top_stories.title: GSIS mulls clean energy investments
top_stories.summary: The Government Service Insurance System is looking at renewable energy as a potential investment area while helping government agencies acquire their own office buildings through a financing initiative.
